## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Port Douglas, Australia. It starts at 4019 Captain Cook Highway WANGETTI.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take a bite out of life at Hartley's Crocodile Adventures! Let the experienced and knowledgeable staff show you how fascinating these scaly creatures can be behind their notoriously toothy grins.
>
> With your Hartley's Crocodile Adventures tickets, climb aboard a safari-style cruise boat to tour the park. Bring your binoculars to do some bird-watching, or scan the surface for signs of what's lurking beneath – like the telltale "crocodile roll".
>
> Get great views of the crocs from the deck overlooking the lagoon and enjoy the chance to see them snacking as boat cruises entice them to feed.
>
> From there, visit the walk-through aviary full of exotic birds, snap a photo of the photogenic koalas and wombats, and get a glimpse of the slithery snakes and ravishing reptiles.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €34.69. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 9 ratings and 4 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
